comparison.objective: Measure a training doll by straightening its sprung legs and closing a footboard; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual restraint of compliant legs while sliding a measuring stop versus precision hex-tool and collar manipulation followed by dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Legs straight and footboard left at a valid length reading versus repeatable non-bottoming stops within specified physical limits.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests tuning and retention of an energy absorber, not compliant-body positioning for measurement.
